proposed_facts.reason: Initialization clears exactly the stated four fields. State 1 decrements the hold timer without suspending the angular-step path; the strict magnitude test clears those fields.

Canonical producer and consumer establish the float-zero guard, sequential clamps, signed speed and decrement, unchecked divisors, feedback requests and hold-before-deceleration behavior. Both observed callers supply unit signs.
Both extrema and their indices start at zero; strict comparisons preserve the described same-sign fallback. Initialization sets x5=1, and its consumer selects the nonrepeating six-index branch.

The complete switch confirms all five states, exact strike windows, integer-cast guards, transition-frame increment, hand/sign selection and overwritten departure timer assignment. The predicate is timer-only.
The helper uses inclusive thresholds 158 and 130 and issues feedback on each true evaluation. Caller and starter guards prevent refreshing a normally active unit-sign rotation.
The ordinary parameterless void wrapper falls through after its call. The contextual generator implementation returns on both object-creation success and failure; no noreturn behavior is established.

The two switches and synchronized helpers support the revised TU explanation. Rotation updates orientation incrementally without an accumulated-motion budget or fixed-orientation restoration; animation completion is checked outside the rotation switch.

contradictions.reason: Accept the six compiled-section fact deferrals and the .sdata2 link deferral. The inspected declarations, archive literal, arithmetic and signed requests establish source behavior but cannot prove section placement, size, constant-pool composition, encodings or alignment.

Accept supersession of the initializer, starter and TU timing explanations: the hold interval delays subtraction of deceleration, not the rotation path. x8 is the current angular step rather than accumulated motion. The starter's float-zero guard must remain distinct from caller integer-cast guards.
Accept supersession of the unqualified leftmost/rightmost explanation: zero-anchored extrema can leave either index at zero for a same-sign table.

Accept supersession of geometric-contact and repeated-refresh explanations. Readiness is only a counter comparison; the caller's bounded windows and integer-cast idle guard cooperate with the starter's float-zero guard. The revised state explanation also preserves the same-call increment and departure timer overwrite.
Accept correction of non-returning terminology: this is a normally returning void lifecycle wrapper, not a noreturn routine.
